author: Animalogic
description:
What if the strangest creatures in history were even more terrifying than we imagine? How big could a prehistoric predator get, and what would happen if you came face-to-face with a giant, saber-toothed beast? From colossal birds with deadly beaks to a whale that ruled the ancient oceans, the past was filled with monsters that sound almost impossible. But just how unbelievable did prehistoric life really get?

00:05 - Meet the 500 Pound Duck That Ruled Australia
17:41 - The Armadillo The Size Of A Beetle (The Car)
35:27 - This "Beaver" Broke Every Rule of Being a Beaver
51:39 - Just How Big Was The Megalodon?
59:58 - The Rise of Giant, Prehistoric Hyena-like Predators
1:11:25 - Thylacosmilus: The Sabertooth With A Pouch
1:18:30 - Terror Birds: The Giant Birds With Guillotine Beaks
1:26:44 - Elasmotherium: The Giant Unicorn That Lived Alongside Humans
1:34:57 - This Prehistoric Sperm Whale Was A Leviathan
